newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hanwa Bk says debts exceed assets by 21.8 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Hanwa Bk says debts exceed assets by 21.8 bln yen.

text.p: The total debts held by Hanwa Bank Ltd exceed its assets by 21.8 billion yen, a senior bank executive told a news conference on Thursday at the bank's headquarters in Western Japan.

Hanwa Bank President Takeshi Shinkyo told reporters that he had resigned to take the responsibility for the bank's financial failure, adding that a senior managing director Zenji Watanabe was named as acting head.
Hanwa meanwhile announced that it posted a parent current loss of 33.72 billin yen in the six months to September 30, after a profit of 232 million yen in the same period a year ago.
